Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summary: The LA Galaxy Juniors & Skills Coach will exemplify high energy, enthusiasm, and professionalism in all Soccer Programming. Programs include Galaxy Juniors, , Skills Training, as well as optional opportunities to coach at birthday parties and in-house league teams. The locations include Galaxy Park (Carson), Kinecta Soccer Center, powered by the LA Galaxy (Torrance) and future locations. As an employee of the LA Galaxy, the Juniors & Skills Coach will build positive relationships with the community and portray a positive image of the LA Galaxy. bloom-bloom:lever:6edfc1ef-c19e-4de1-8f6.title: VP of Marketing | Poppy & Peonies
bloom-bloom:lever:6edfc1ef-c19e-4de1-8f6.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a VP of Marketing to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally. Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported! We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint. About the Role We are seeking an experienced and visionary Vice President of Marketing to lead our brand’s next stage of growth. This role is ideal for a senior marketing leader with deep expertise in creative strategy, social media, and brand storytelling. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on building campaigns that not only resonate with customers but also strengthen long-term brand equity. As VP of Marketing, you will oversee the full marketing function, from campaign ideation to execution, ensuring seamless integration across channels. You will be responsible for shaping the marketing strategy, scaling multi-channel initiatives, and bringing the Poppy & Peonies brand to life with consistency, creativity, and measurable impact. This leader will partner closely with executive leadership to drive growth, inspire cross-functional collaboration, and build a high-performing marketing team.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:5d466e42-.description: ABOUT GEN Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen. About our Partner Team The Partner team at Gen is one of the company's most strategic growth engines — and the platform we build is what makes it all possible. We partner with global carriers, financial institutions, retailers, and employee benefits platforms to bring Gen's award-winning cyber safety, identity protection, and financial wellness solutions directly to their customers — embedded within partner experiences through co-branded and white-labeled integrations. This B2B2C model reaches millions of additional consumers worldwide and generates significant revenue at scale. We don't just manage partner relationships — we co-create go-to-market strategies with our most strategic partners and build the technical platform infrastructure that turns those strategies into shipped, scalable product. The Partner team owns many delivery methods including but not limited to APIs, SDKs, and Identity & Access Management capabilities that determine how fast we grow and how seamlessly partners integrate Gen's solutions into their own experiences. The Role We're looking for a Senior Principal Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Gen's partner-facing APIs and SDKs — the technical integration layer that determines how quickly and seamlessly our global partner ecosystem can embed Gen's cyber safety, identity, and financial wellness products into their own experiences. This is a technical individual contributor role. You'll define what great looks like for partners integrating with Gen — from API design standards and SDK architecture to authentication flows and developer onboarding — and you'll drive the roadmap that makes it real. The scope of your work directly shapes how fast the partner channel grows, how reliably partners can deliver Gen's products to their end users, and how strong the developer experience is for the technical teams on the other side of our integrations. The right candidate has built API and SDK products at scale. You know the difference between an API that works and one that developers love. You've defined SDK patterns across multiple platforms and languages. You understand IAM as a product surface — not just a security requirement — and you can hold your own in architecture conversations with senior engineers while simultaneously translating technical trade-offs into business impact for executive stakeholders. What You'll Own API Design & Standards Own the design, versioning, and quality bar for Gen's partner-facing APIs. infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: AI ENGINEER (CONTRACT-TO-HIRE) Location: Remote (Global, EST working hours) Start Date: Rolling Please apply using the provided form, candidates who directly email will not be considered. ABOUT THE PROJECT We're building AI-native engineering team within Infinity, a holding company building full-stack AI businesses. We support portfolio companies by: - Rapidly prototyping new product ideas to validate markets - Providing flex capacity during high-growth phases - Maintaining and evolving the Gravity our in house software factory and agent hub that we use to build all software. We’re not a dev shop. We’re a surgical team of builders who move fast, reduce ambiguity, and create leverage across a network of founders building with AI at the core. THE ROLE We’re looking for scrappy, sharp, execution-focused engineers who thrive in high-autonomy environments. You'll be deployed on fast-moving projects; from validating ideas in one-week sprints to helping scale production tools inside early-stage companies. This is a contract-to-hire role. If there’s mutual fit, you’ll transition to a full-time or retainer-based role within the core team. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build working prototypes of agentic AI applications, LLM workflows, and full-stack products - Experiment quickly across frameworks, open source tools, and low-code stacks - Interface directly with product thinkers and founders to distill ambiguous ideas into testable code - Contribute to shared internal libraries and the Infinity Commons and add features to Gravity, our software factory platform. - Occasionally embed with portfolio companies to support launches or unblock execution WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Required: - Fluency in Python and experience using AI toolkits and APIs - Experience rapidly building and iterating on proof-of-concept or MVPs - Comfort using a blend of commercial APIs, open source, and low-code tooling to get things done - Strong problem-solving skills and analytical intuition Bonus Points: - Prior work with AI agents, and a deep familiarity with what it takes to make them work well in production environments. - Experience with frontend development (React, Next.js, etc.) - A background in a STEM discipline, data science, or quant-heavy engineering you'll need to be able to show the impact of your work with statistical significance - Previous experience in a venture-backed startup or technical founder role HOW WE WORK - Asynchronous by default, with tight feedback loops and clear ownership - High-trust, high-autonomy culture that values shipping, learning, and iterating - Small, elite team of senior builders with experience across AI, product, and infrastructure HOW TO APPLY Send us: - A short note in the application form on why this role fits you Links to past work, projects, or GitHub. - Availability to start the contract phase We’ll move quickly. If it feels like a fit, you’ll be coding real things with us within a week.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:68ca2760-dd41-.title: Senior Back End Engineer - Sportsbook
jobgether-jobgether:lever:68ca2760-dd41-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Back End Engineer – Sportsbook based in France. This is a senior engineering opportunity to help build a brand-new Sportsbook platform from the ground up. You will play a key role in shaping the backend architecture, technical foundations, and engineering practices behind a global gaming product. The position covers the full software development lifecycle, from understanding product requirements and system design through deployment, testing, and maintenance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to turn ambitious product ideas into scalable and reliable technical solutions. As a senior technical contributor, you will influence architectural decisions, improve system performance, and establish strong engineering standards. The environment is agile, fast-moving, and highly collaborative, offering substantial ownership over the technology being built. It is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a new Sportsbook product and help define its technical direction from day one. Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient backend services for a new Sportsbook platform. Contribute to the end-to-end development lifecycle, from framing product requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate with product, engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical specifications. Lead architectural discussions and make informed technology decisions that improve scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Design and implement large-scale distributed systems capable of supporting a growing gaming platform. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues across backend services and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, testing approaches, and code-review processes. Contribute to CI/CD practices and deployment automation to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Help shape the technical roadmap and architecture of the Sportsbook as the product evolves. Requirements: Proven experience building and launching a Sports betting application from scratch, with strong understanding of the technical requirements of Sportsbook platforms. 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in Java and/or Kotlin and Spring . Demonstrated experience designing and implementing large-scale software systems, particularly distributed and highly scalable backend systems. Strong understanding of backend architecture, system design, scalability, performance, and reliability. Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-based application environments. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently. Ability to lead technical discussions, influence architectural decisions, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in an agile, cross-functional environment. Good command of English, equivalent to at least B2 level . Benefits: Opportunity to build a new Sportsbook platform from the ground up and directly influence its architecture and technology. High level of technical ownership and visibility across a new product initiative. Opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed backend systems and challenging engineering problems. Collaborative and agile working environment with cross-functional teams. Ability to shape engineering standards, architectural decisions, and development practices from an early stage. Opportunity to contribute to an ambitious global gaming product and help shape its future.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:cc5fb6fa-1d2.description: Welo Data is looking for experienced, detail-oriented professionals to join our team as Data Quality Analysts. This role sits at the center of execution and quality — bridging Data Labeling Associates (DLAs) and Team Leads to ensure work is not only completed, but done right.
